title: Conformal risk control for model-form uncertainty in parametric non-intrusive reduced-order models
abstract: arXiv:2608.03360v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Non-intrusive reduced-order models (NIROMs) have become a standard tool for approximating parametric partial differential equations from computer design of experiments while significantly reducing computational costs. However, assessing the reliability of their predictions remains a major challenge, particularly in extrapolation regimes or under limited training data. In this work, we introduce a framework for quantifying model-form uncertainty in NIROMs by combining a perturbative stochastic representation of reduced bases with distribution-free conformal-type methods. Starting from a deterministic reduced basis constructed from snapshot matrices, we model uncertainty through random perturbations defined on the Stiefel manifold, directed along the discarded modes, yielding stochastic reduced-order approximations whose induced variance reflects the basis-truncation error. A transport approximation gives a closed-form posterior

translated_title: 参数化非侵入式降阶模型中模型形式不确定性的保形风险控制
translated_abstract: 非侵入式降阶模型（NIROMs）已成为从计算机实验设计出发近似参数化偏微分方程的标准工具，同时能显著降低计算成本。然而，评估其预测的可靠性仍然是一个重大挑战，尤其是在外推区域或训练数据有限的情况下。在本工作中，我们通过将降阶基的微扰随机表示与无分布假设的保形类方法相结合，引入了一个量化NIROMs中模型形式不确定性的框架。从由快照矩阵构建的确定性降阶基出发，我们通过定义在Stiefel流形上、沿被舍弃模态方向的随机扰动来建模不确定性，从而得到随机降阶近似，其诱导的方差反映了基截断误差。一种输运近似给出了闭式后验……
tldr: 该论文提出将Stiefel流形上沿被舍弃模态方向的随机扰动降阶基与无分布保形方法相结合的框架，用于量化非侵入式降阶模型的模型形式不确定性，其诱导方差反映基截断误差，从而为预测可靠性提供统计保证。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes a framework combining stochastic perturbations of reduced bases on the Stiefel manifold along discarded modes with distribution-free conformal methods to quantify model-form uncertainty in NIROMs, where the induced variance reflects basis-truncation error and provides statistical guarantees for prediction reliability.
